title: Philippines blocks Greece livestock imports
desc: The Philippines has temporarily banned livestock and animal product imports from Greece after confirmed foot-and-mouth disease cases, tightening border inspections and suspending permits to protect local farmers, food security and the domestic livestock industry.

title: Chandranath Rath Murder: Chandranath Rath killing: Mother of 'sharpshooter' Raj Singh rejects police theory in Suvendu Adhikari aide's murder probe
desc:
Amid the ongoing probe into the murder of Chandranath Rath, personal assistant to West Bengal CM Suvendu Adhikari, the mother of arrested Ballia resident and alleged sharpshooter Raj Singh has claimed that her son was with family members in Lucknow and Ayodhya when the ambush took place in Madhyamgram in North 24 Parganas on May 6.
Jamvanti Singh, while speaking to journalists at her home, said Raj Singh had travelled with her to Lucknow on May 7 to attend the wedding of the daughter of a local MLC, identified as Pappu Singh.
She claimed the group included Raj Singh, a driver, one of his friends, another acquaintance and herself.
According to her, the family stayed at a guest house near the wedding venue in Lucknow.

title: Stunning fossil discovery challenges the origins of animal life
desc: Scientists revisiting mysterious 540-million-year-old microfossils from Brazil have overturned a major idea about early animal life. What were once thought to be trails left behind by tiny worm-like creatures are now believed to be fossilized communities of bacteria and algae — some with remarkably preserved cells and organic material still intact.

title: Double Olympic track cycling champion Katie Archibald announces retirement: “It’s simply time”
desc: The three-time Olympic medallist and women’s Madison trailblazer publicly announced her retirement on Tuesday, 12 May, shifting focus from track cycling to nursing.
